notes.title: Cheer-Up-Date | Autopsy Simulator Free Update | OUT NOW 💉
notes.content:
[h3]How's it going Pathologists? 🥼[/h3]

[b]We’ve heard you (Just as you heard Jack sighing)! We’re introducing the Cheer-Up-Date for Autopsy Simulator.[/b] This update brings changes to Jack’s voice lines, removing some of his sighing during Dead Memories Story Mode and making overall improvements to his voice lines.

Alongside [b]changes to Jack’s voice lines[/b], the Cheer-Up-Date brings multiple [b]improvements to existing features and further bug fixes[/b] across both Autopsy Simulator game modes- Dead Memories Story Mode & Autopsy Only Mode. 

[b]We hope you've kept your scalpels sharp and enjoy the new free update from Autopsy Simulator on Steam! 🔪[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/4218a8de493ae33f3bf031297487fda1af34e39c.png[/img]
[h1]⚙️ Cheer-Up-Date - Patch Notes ⚙️[/h1]
[h2]Overall Changes[/h2]
[h3]Changes to Jack's Voice Lines[/h3]
[list][*] Improvements to Jack Hanman’s voice lines throughout Autopsy Simulator, removing the number of sighs throughout Dead Memories Story Mode.
[*] Increased Jack’s audio levels Chapter 5 to ensure all voice lines can be heard correctly.[/list][h3]Improvements to both Game Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improvements to controller support, including:
[list][*] Players can now switch between Controller and Mouse & Keyboard more conveniently.[/list][*] Improvements to button remapping/rebinding.
[*] Improvements to the file save slots to improve their stability.
[*] Improvements to UV light during external inspections.
[*] Improvements to Rigor Mortis mini-game, with the cursor now removed during the procedure for added immersion.
[*]Overall improvements to the in-game settings, with settings now appearing with players saved values at all times.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes in both Game Modes[/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue where pausing whilst using the Tools menu could result in players using a tool when resuming the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where Chromatic Aberration would not apply correctly after enabling it in the graphics options.
[*] Fixed an issue where Film Grain would not apply correctly after enabling it in the graphics options.[/list][h3]Localisation Improvements[/h3][list][*] Improvements to Korean and Japanese languages, removing Tofu symbols for all languages.[/list][h2]Dead Memories[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Improvements to HUD and button prompts when holding the camera and interacting with a cadaver.
[*] Improvements to lighting of the autopsy room and morgue, to make lighting more consistent across all Chapters of Dead Memories Story Mode.
[*] Improvements to lighting & texture of centrifuge lamp.
[*] Improvements to controller input functionality, including changes to left stick movements which now only control one object at a time.
[*] Improvements to the running water sound effects in morgue bathroom.
[*] Improvements to the lighting of the morgue exterior and parking lot.
[*] Improvements to Mr. Ridley’s motion during Chapter 1.
[*] Reduced the sensitivity of the fingerprint ink mini-game during Chapter 2.
[*] Reduced the sensitivity of the syringe mini-game with glycerin during Chapter 2.
[*] Improvements to brush pigment sensitivity for teeth cast during Chapter 3 and Chapter 4. 
[*] Improvements to the Electric Suction Device sound effects during Chapter 4.
[*] Improvements in Chapter 5 to Steven’s animations.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes [/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, where the sound effect of the first cut organ would loop.
[*] Fixed an issue where lighting & textures would occasionally flicker in the hallway.
[*] Fixed an issue where the video camera could clip through the player when they looked down.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, where the heart wound icon would occasionally appear on the wrong side of the heart. Icon now appears in the correct injury area.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, where the photo of Alice and Charlotte would clip through the envelope.
[*] Fixes in Chapter 2 with the elevator lighting and elevator floor buttons.
[*] Fixes to the bucket in Chapter 2, including:[list][*] Fixed an issue where the bucket would occasionally be missing for players if misplaced, causing a softlock when putting the lungs in the bucket.
[*] Fixed an occasional animation issue when placing the bucket on the sink.
[*] Fixed an issue where the water bucket would occasionally remain empty after filling.[/list][*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 2 with fingerprint scanning. Selecting another fingerprint after getting the right match does not interrupt mini-game progress.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 2 where occasionally an objective would not trigger until players left the cutting board or body.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 3, where the tires would appear as unlashed and normal for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 3, where “Alligator Mississippiensis” was present on a sticky note before comparing the scales to the atlas, causing the player to have the identification result before conducting the comparison.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 3, where the atlas could clip through the shelf when rotated.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 4, where the cursor would reset position after each action with the lopper.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 5, where one of Alice’s voice lines was missing.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 5, where Jack would be occasionally stood upright during the chapter’s opening scene.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 5, where the flashlight was too bright when close to objects.
[*] Fixed a graphical issue during [spoiler]Chapter 5’s secret ending.[/spoiler][/list][h2]Autopsy Only Mode[/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3][list][*] Improvements to scoring in Autopsy Only Mode.
[*] Improvements to organs’ physics, with all accurate organs now reacting to the player’s movements and will bounce during clipboard reporting.
[*] Improved the sensitivity during organ cutting, increasing the dot sensitivity during maze mini-games.
[*] Improvements to bite marks, making their sizing more consistent across the game mode.
[*] Removal of occasional visible seams on cadavers.
[*] Removal of traces on internal organs when inspecting with the UV light.[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*] Removal of occasional visible seams on cadavers.
[*] Removal of traces on internal organs when inspecting with the UV light.
[*] Fixed an issue with the cadaver outline, which now is seen around the severed skull once removed from cadaver.
[*] Fixed an issue where the scalpel would clip through the head, neck and chest area of one of the cadavers.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor was removed if players selected the police folder and clipboard at the same time.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to pick up an organ, pause the game and interact with the organ whilst in the pause menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor would occasionally hide for gameplay after a failed Rigor Mortis.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cadaver’s skin flaps would occasionally stutter when opening.[/list]

notes.title: Autopsy Only Mode - OUT NOW | Free Update for Autopsy Simulator!
notes.content:
[h2]Autopsy Only Mode is OUT NOW! 💉 [/h2]
Hey Pathologists! 👋 Today we've released a free simulation-focused content update, which brings the arrival of Autopsy Only Mode to Autopsy Simulator. Ready to test your skills in the Autopsy Room?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/90eb417268208b98a578c68d1b29986ad73ce75d.png[/img]

[h3]Autopsy Only Mode - Key Features[/h3]
[b]🧑‍⚕️ Simulation gameplay focus:[/b] Step into the shoes of a student pathologist and conduct autopsies correctly by following the accurate flow and procedures in the Autopsy Room to get the best final rating and score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/0091bb9fb37cc0641548d9ade6d28d7eb0c3a6a5.gif[/img]

[b]🔁 Follow the correct autopsy flow:[/b] Ensure all areas of the internal and external examinations are conducted and performed well. If some procedures during the autopsy are skipped, players will be docked points from their final score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/d4feadfedcb3f3c9ab3f553651e78f6164df46c2.gif[/img]

[b]🤔 Final cause of death judgement:[/b] In Autopsy Only Mode, there are seven generic causes of death across all cadavers and three unique causes of death, one per cadaver in Autopsy Only Mode. 

When you begin your game of AOM, there are eight possible causes of death for each body. Select the correct cause of death for the cadaver to gain points and a better final rank in Autopsy Only Mode!

We've also added fourteen decoy causes of death, to add more randomness to the game mode and increase replayability! Decoy causes of death create misdirection, whilst developing the narrative of the events unfolding as you progress through the autopsy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/5a2b79e89a39be3f31203b599cf7e47af06753c2.gif[/img]

[b]💯 Get scored on your autopsy performance:[/b] In Autopsy Only Mode, you'll be scored on several criteria, including Minigame Score, Planning & Preparations, Unnecessary Examinations, Final Cause of Death, and Clean Up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/4e2bc0d55e184d6cf8048f8a74883e81cdbbf3b6.gif[/img]

All choices during the new game mode will affect your final score, so make sure you're making decisive decisions in the Autopsy Room to ensure the best Autopsy Only Mode score. Make sure to photograph every integral area of the cadaver, only dissect organs crucial to the case files, and of course... remember to put your medical gloves on! 🧤

Alongside this, ensure you are cutting organs correctly and not failing any minigames, as this will cause you to lose score.

[h3]Dead Memories Improvements[/h3]
Our free update for Autopsy Simulator also contains improvements and tweaks to our Dead Memories story mode! The changes in this patch have come from your Dead Memories launch feedback and include improvements to the scare trigger points to make scares easier to experience, improved flow throughout Dead Memories by holding players during conversations with NPCs that include important plot points, tweaks to the secret ending to make this easier to trigger, and more!

[b]Find out more about our new game mode addition in Autopsy Only Mode and our changes to Dead Memories in our full patch notes: ⬇️[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #20 - Autopsy Only Mode launches on 12th December!
notes.content:
Hey Pathologists!

[b] In case you missed it, we recently announced that a free content update will arrive on 12th December, which brings the full release of our simulation-focused game mode 'Autopsy Only Mode' to Autopsy Simulator.[/b]

Today, we have Autopsy Only Mode news and new screenshots to share from our upcoming update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/9119770271dc5945156da895b30d7c03de70b676.gif[/img]

In Autopsy Only Mode, you'll step into the shoes of a student pathologist. Conduct autopsies to get scored based on your performance, so ensure you're following the accurate flow and procedures in the Autopsy Room to get the best score and rank! You'll be scored based on performance via the following criteria:[list][*] Minigame Score
[*] Planning & Preparations
[*] Unnecessary Examinations
[*] Final Cause of Death
[*] Clean Up[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/f5625253a69189736b26788ee2975aa54b5dd2fd.png[/img]
Alongside Autopsy Only Mode's arrival, this week's update will bring alterations to Dead Memories. We've been making tweaks to the story mode based on community feedback and will have further details on this later in Devlog #20!
[h2]What's new for Autopsy Only Mode?[/h2]
Since our last PTE update in November, we've made several alterations and improvements to our upcoming simulation-focused game mode, ready for full launch on 12th December. These Autopsy Only Mode changes include:
[h3]Improved Injuries & Textures[/h3]
We've enhanced the realism in the Autopsy Room by implementing new and improved textures to Autopsy Only Mode, since PTE Update 3! This includes alterations to cadavers' injuries and improvements to the textures of scarring, cuts and more for Autopsy Only Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/653414767a0ff4f10bc6365c3e643b82f8796acf.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/9a15074f5eba17ce5654e562908e26ef6cf39dbc.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/c91990823e59fbbb1549b4fb54ffe7a5907c3bd1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Third Cadaver & Unique Causes of Death[/h3]
During the PTE process, the community playtested Autopsy Only Mode with two cadavers. Since then, we've made alterations to these cadavers and added the third body for AOM's full launch! Below are screenshots of these cadavers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/d36432334fe3587ba7dbdff300fdae9b42171f5b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/b133f5464d7b377f880b2360e0bfbda79a05f8f3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/8f387389dca84bf817ca13b902645bd081d5725c.png[/img]
When you select Autopsy Only Mode, one of the three cadavers will be selected at random to dissect. Alongside this, each cadaver will spawn with randomised facial hair style and head design for cadavers in Autopsy Only Mode.

In our previous Devlog, we've discussed the ten total causes of death included in Autopsy Only Mode! The game mode contains seven generic causes of death across all cadavers and three unique causes of death, one per cadaver. This means that when you begin your Autopsy Only Mode game, you'll select from eight causes of death. Selecting the correct cause of death will score you more points in our new game mode.

[h3]New Achievements for AOM[/h3]
We've seen community questions regarding Achievements for our new simulation-focused game mode. We're pleased to announce that Autopsy Only Mode brings eleven new achievements for Autopsy Simulator, all unlocked during our new game mode.

We hope you're looking forward to getting back into the Autopsy Room this week and unlocking them all!

[h3]Dead Memories Improvements[/h3]
Alongside the release of our new game mode for Autopsy Simulator, our free update on December 12th will bring some tweaks and changes to Dead Memories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/df4caf13f5e5f43eba00b3498ab5f886ea0abf06.gif[/img]

The team has been working on bug fixes, based on Dead Memories community feedback. This includes fixing an issue where some horror elements would not trigger, making the second alternative ending easier to occur, and more! 🤝

We've also made some alterations to the organ cutting in Dead Memories, by implementing AOM organ cutting improvements into the story mode. Along with this addition, we've made some minor tweaks and bug fixes to improve your experience with Dead Memories! Learn more about Dead Memories story mode on our Steam page below: ⬇️

notes.title: Autopsy Only Mode launches on 12th December!
notes.content:
Hey Pathologists! 👋🧑‍⚕️

Today, we have great news to share, as after multiple Autopsy Only Mode PTE updates, we have a confirmed launch date for our Autopsy Only Mode free content update for Autopsy Simulator.

[h3]Autopsy Only Mode will launch on December 12th for Autopsy Simulator![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/9119770271dc5945156da895b30d7c03de70b676.gif[/img]
[h2]Autopsy Only Mode - Key Features[/h2]
Head back into the Autopsy Room on December 12th to experience our new simulation-focused game mode!

Step into the shoes of a student pathologist and conduct autopsies correctly by following the accurate flow and procedures in the Autopsy Room to get the best final rating and score! In Autopsy Only Mode, you'll be scored based on several specific criteria, including:

[b]The flow of the autopsy:[/b] Players need to ensure all areas of the internal and external examinations are conducted and performed well. If some procedures during the autopsy are skipped, players will be docked points from their final score.

It could be as simple as forgetting to photograph an integral area of the cavader or as big as forgetting to examine an organ. All choices during the new game mode will affect your final score, so make sure you're making decisive decisions in the Autopsy Room to ensure the best Autopsy Only Mode score! Alongside this, ensure you are cutting organs correctly and not failing any minigames, as this will cause you to lose score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/0fe8f5b99ea9579fd27d8db52858b45491d42b96.gif[/img]

[b]Final cause of death judgement:[/b] In Autopsy Only Mode, there are seven generic causes of death across all cadavers and three unique causes of death, one per cadaver in Autopsy Only Mode. When you begin your game of AOM, there are eight possible causes of death for each body. Select the correct cause of death for the cadaver to gain points and a better final rank in Autopsy Only Mode!

To do so, ensure you've been thorough in your examinations and review your notes in your clipboard tabs. Also, we've added fourteen decoy causes of death, to add more randomness to the game mode and increase AOM's replayability! Decoy causes of death create misdirection, whilst developing the narrative of the events unfolding as you progress through the autopsy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/a360ae05c6cfac51c9da6504cc8be4e43ff9b502.gif[/img]

[h3]Stuck during your time in the Autopsy Room?[/h3]
If you're struggling during your Autopsy Only Mode playthrough, here are two elements that will quickly help you on December 12th:

[b]New Tape recorder: [/b]Utilise Jack's knowledge through his pre-recorded audio tapes, which acts as a guide for Autopsy Only Mode and contains useful information about the flow of the Autopsy procedure.

Already a master in the Autopsy Room? There's an option to turn off the tapes in Autopsy Only Mode for those who want to experience the game mode without this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/97c5c22ff67ed1d63733092b41b69023a1c5d8b1.png[/img]

[b]New Blackboard: [/b]We've altered the blackboards in our new game mode so they are clearer for the workflow of Autopsy Only Mode. Here you will view each stage of the autopsy procedure and the ordering of tasks to complete in the Autopsy Room.

Following the blackboard's order will benefit your final scoring during our Autopsy Only Mode game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/a5da150f5ff3942542ed6f97d35e6f76292adc65.gif[/img]

[h3]PTE News[/h3]
We want to thank you all for playtesting Autopsy Only Mode since the start of our PTEs for the game mode in September. Your feedback, suggestions and comments during the PTE process have helped us make Autopsy Only Mode the best game mode it can be! 🖤

[i][u]NOTE: Our PTE is currently in English Only. We'll be looking to add more languages soon, but as this is a pre-alpha build the game mode is in English only. AOM will feature more languages in full release![/u][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/6c9ec6ff3c0ba0788c0ddf49f75b5a402c28bc01.jpg[/img]

Although we've fixed a number of bugs found in our previous playtest, the PTE build remains a pre-alpha meaning you'll likely run into issues throughout your playthrough. Our Known Issues list is below:

[h3]Softlock Issues:[/h3]
Issue: Changing the Action button in the Controls menu makes neither LMB nor the new button working in menus for Autopsy Only Mode.
What to do: Avoid changing the action button. Our settings are a work in progress for this build, so this functionality is not yet finalized.

Issue: After finishing a blood test, if you quickly interact with another object or pull away from the blood test the game can softlock. 
What to do: When finishing blood test with microscope, avoid quickly pressing the left mouse button. The cursor icon can be visible and still cause a softlock, so wait until your character's point of view has returned before left clicking.

Issue: The pipette screen can occasionally softlock.
What to do:  The pipette may stay in the players control after completing the mini game, which blocks moving on. If happens it should be safe to restart the game mode.

Issue: Checking blood under a microscope occasionally softlocks the game.
What to do: If the blood under the microscope freezes, try to exit with right mouse button. If this continues, restart via the pause menu.

[h3]Other Issues:[/h3]
Issue: Putting on gloves and aprons on at the end of an autopsy may cause players to revive points towards their final score. This is a current error and does not impact gameplay.

Issue: Players are unable to highlight wounds on the clipboard in Autopsy Only Mode. The Clipboard is not finalized yet and is a work in progress.

Issue: Whilst remapped to a different button, the tab button will open but not close.
What to do: Avoid button remapping. Our settings are a work in progress at this stage of development.

Issue: Settings control options can be inconsistent in Autopsy Only Mode. Our current settings menus are still a work in progress for AOM and will be finalized for future builds/for the full launch of Autopsy Only Mode.

Issue: Button prompts do not change when button remapping in Autopsy Only Mode and can display the wrong buttons when changing controls.
What to do: Avoid button remapping. Our settings are a work in progress at this stage of development.

Issue: The controls menu and options inside this menu react with a delay in Autopsy Only Mode. These settings are a work in progress and will be updated soon.

Issue: Entering the Pause Menu and pressing Back while interacting with the cadaver makes parts of the interface disappear.
What to do: Re-entering the Pause Menu brings the UI back.

Issue: Some sound effects are missing from Autopsy Only Mode, as sound effects are still a work in progress for the game mode.

Issue: After cutting the top of the cadaver’s head, the area can remain marked as an interactive zone when this action is complete. This is a visual issue and has no impact on gameplay.

Issue: If you turn censorship on and draw blood from the cadaver, it results in one pixel being coloured red in Autopsy Only Mode. This issue has no impact on gameplay.

Issue: The incorrect voice-over is triggered when picking up the liver in Autopsy Only Mode. Our sound effects are not yet finalised for Autopsy Only Mode.

Issue: When opening up the chest of the cadaver, there’s currently no animation for the stringed fluid beneath the chest. This is a visual issue only.

Issue: Shadow resolution cannot be changed in the graphics settings menu in Autopsy Only Mode. Our settings are still a work in progress and will be finalised later for Autopsy Only Mode.

Issue: A ‘Skip’ prompt will appear in the lower right corner whilst some voiceover lines are active, which currently is unusable. This is a work in progress and this button is currently a visual placeholder. It will function in the final version/future builds of Autopsy Only Mode.

Issue: The page for marking and noting wounds on organ’s can sometimes be incorrect, marking on the main page instead in Autopsy Only Mode. The clipboard is a work in progress and its functionality is not yet final.

Issue: Music is not present in Autopsy Only Mode. Our music and sound effects are not yet finalised for Autopsy Only Mode’s PTE.

[b]What to do: [/b]For a fully immersive experience start every autopsy by doing photos.

[b]What to do:[/b] Button mapping is still being worked on, avoid remapping buttons.

notes.content:
[h3]Dear Pathomorphologists,[/h3]

Today, we want to discuss: our [b]future free content update Autopsy Only Mode[/b], which will bring more simulation gameplay, and [b]clarify the differences between Dead Memories and the upcoming Autopsy Only Mode.[/b]

Before jumping into the points of the Devlog above, we want to thank the community for all the feedback around Autopsy Simulator since our launch yesterday. We want to reassure you all that we're hearing your feedback around simulation gameplay, our narrative mode Dead Memories, AOM's future features, and more. All of your feedback and suggestions here on Steam are monitored and raised to the team working on Autopsy Simulator.

[h3]Autopsy Only Mode[/h3]
Firstly, we want to discuss Autopsy Only Mode, the upcoming free update to Autopsy Simulator! Yesterday, we announced our Autopsy Only Mode is now in development, bringing a new sandbox-style game mode to Autopsy Simulator. Below is some key information regarding our upcoming game mode:

- Autopsy Only Mode takes place in the morgue only, with players able to interact with items and tools in the morgue's key rooms. This includes the Laboratory, Storeroom, and the integral area, the Dissection Room.

- This content update will focus on simulation gameplay, with players' Autopsy Examinations being scored in a grading system. Your score will be determined by several variables including the timing and speed of your work, the flow of the autopsy, performance in tests, and more. Tests in Autopsy Only Mode can be failed, which will have a larger effect on your final scoring.

- Autopsy Only Mode features randomised causes of death. It's your aim to examine the body, conduct external and internal tests, and correctly verify the patient's cause of death. Then it's time to close and stitch up the body before discovering your final score!

[h3]Dead Memories[/h3]
We'd also like to use this Devlog to [b]clarify the features of Dead Memories, our standalone game mode which released yesterday:[/b]

- Dead Memories is a story based game mode. You play as Jack Hanman, a middle-aged pathologist. After a career downfall and the loss of your beloved wife, you live each day exhausted. One day during a post-mortem, you find a relic of your past hidden inside a body. Now, it feels like something just won’t let go. Follow the journey of Jack, a practice pathologist and unravel the mystery of both the patients deaths' and discover more about Jack's life, which has taken a turn for the worst.

- Our story mode is a blend of two contrasting genres- Psychological Horror and Medical-Sim gameplay. This game mode is narrative-driven, with five bodies to dissect, and contains several horror moments and jumpscares throughout.

- Dead Memories contains five hours of content, with the story mode containing multiple endings.

- Dead Memories is our standalone game mode for launch which contains five hours of content, with Autopsy Only Mode implemented in an upcoming free update. Autopsy Only Mode brings more simulation gameplay in the future, with more details found below!

More details around our story mode development focus can be found in our previous Devlog #15: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1283230/announcements/detail/4155203895320417328?snr=2___

[b]We're excited to bring our 'Autopsy Only Mode' to our game and know the community is eager to see more details of this game mode soon![/b] We hope you'll be patient with us while our team works hard to improve Autopsy Simulator and work on our upcoming content update, which will see more simulation gameplay added to our game!

We'll have more details to share about Autopsy Only Mode soon- until then, keep those scalpels sharp! 🔪

notes.title: Devlog #16 - Gold Master, Autopsy Tools & Final Development Progress
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Pathomorphologists,[/h3]

We're extremely pleased to announce that Autopsy Simulator has gone gold! We want to begin by thanking you all for supporting us- it's been a long development journey since the creation of Autopsy Simulator, which has spanned over the last four years. We genuinely appreciate your patience whilst we've been making our psychological horror simulator game the best it can be! The gold master of the game is ready for players to experience on 6th June and we cannot wait to see your first impressions of Autopsy Simulator!

Alongside this news, we have new screenshots from our gold master build to share with you all! 👀 But before we jump into this, we want to run the community through all the main tools you have at your disposal in the Autopsy Room.

[h2]Autopsy Tools[/h2]
[h3]Magnifier[/h3]
After documenting the cadaver in the condition it arrived with the Polaroid camera, we need to take a closer inspection of the areas with external abnormalities before we document these on our report. It's worth remembering the context around the scene of the death. You'll do so via the police report, which you'll read before conducting each autopsy. This allows you to interpret any traces found on the body during the magnifier inspection.

To use the Magnifier tool, select Magnifier on the tool wheel and begin to examine the areas highlighted on the body. In the example below, we're investigating the which seems to contain a bite mark. We'll need to jot that down and inspect this further into the examination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/db5f7b01c4b7a84cd485877f586b23294aaaf003.gif[/img]
[h3]UV Lamp[/h3]
Need to check for external traces? The good old UV Lamp is the tool you'll need for conducting external analysis during your autopsy. Select this tool and scan the whole body, looking closely and carefully for any UV ray traces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/9e2b7664769c57915c4b5a4d7e1934bf0da38e0b.gif[/img]
[h3]Scalpel[/h3]
Moving from external to internal, we'll need to cut open the body and begin the remainder of the examination. Grab the Scalpel tool to begin cutting. The incision should be in the shape of the letter 'Y'. Use a deep cut to reach the ribs and penetrate the abdominal wall. Once the body is fully cut open, we peel back and separate the skin to perform the internal examination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/b288729330384299a6bac09c2f5abff0077fd4cf.gif[/img]
[h3]Loppers[/h3]
The loppers are a crucial tool for the internal examination. Use the Lopper tool to remove the ribs from the body. This will allow you to explore the main organs below, including the heart and lungs. (We'd like to say that the loppers have a very satisfying crunch sound.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/5039d79a983a2f0755df16ef3475daf7d7dbd2cb.gif[/img]
[h3]Saw[/h3]
Next up, we have the oscillating saw. Utilise this tool to inspect the brain for abnormalities by opening up the cranium. The cut with the saw is made from ear to ear. After which, remove the skin and the top of the skull and then cut the brain starting from the occipital lobe. In this way, the dura mater of the brain is slowly exposed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/9511f87a088f0cb8da75e39e1947e986838444ae.gif[/img]

Once the cut of the cranium is complete, we can perform a basic examination of the brain. You may need to examine the brain further by taking a cross-section on the cutting board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/533b957861bccb99d90846b547b735b5eae476b4.gif[/img]
[h3]Syringe[/h3]
Taking samples from the cadaver is useful for toxicological tests. To do so, we select the Syringe tool and draw blood from the key highlighted areas. In the example below, we're taking samples from three organs to be sure of alcohol levels in the body. We draw 5ml of blood from the eyeball, the heart, and the bladder, for later analysis which will rule out or confirm if alcohol poisoning was the cause of death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/adadf82ff99d9b82435700374b672a60c04dcecd.gif[/img]
[h3]Needle[/h3]
Finished the autopsy and found the cause of death? Once you've added your signature to the Autopsy Summary Report documentation, the case is solved- but for us, this is not the end. We need to close the body and grab the needle tool. Unroll the skin flaps and sew the deceased back up using the 'Baseball Stitch' technique- a strong and quick stitch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/dfe06a57cf3e712325ce160b9e1d82a7aa6cdb01.gif[/img]

We recently made changes to our Needle tool to enhance its realism! This has been achieved by updating the stitch style and adding a pulled skin effect to this tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/b85cc5df3566a7d0c689a58c88a2aadae852d17b.png[/img]
Alongside the tools above, several pieces of equipment you'll need during specific autopsy examinations are placed around the Autopsy Room, the Laboratory, and even a few in the Cellar. 👀 This includes Microscope Examinations, Fax Machine and PC Database Analysis, Fingerprint Examinations, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/395df74f888b2cf2dcde4d35eefa88ce87f886ca.gif[/img]
[h2]Before and After Screenshots[/h2]
We began working on Autopsy Simulator in 2020, and we've recently flicked back through old files to gather screenshots of our first builds and early concept art to compare this to our gold master! We hope you enjoy these progress images:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/c209c47baca92a60bc35aada4c62dea9599adc56.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/aa4f80663f43aee34b5062a83a99915d5a8da422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/85056f5de2f2402d86e629ba9f918345eec26fd1.jpg[/img]

👋 That's all for today- we cannot wait to see you on June 6th for the launch of Autopsy Simulator.

notes.title: Devlog #13 - Lucky 13
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Pathomorphologists,[/h3]

For those of you who have already thrown off your apron, don't put it down, because we have some good news from our dissecting room and you may need it!

Even though it's still August on the calendar, autumn weather is slowly creeping up on us. Well, not only us, because in Petesville, with our pathologist, the first cold rains are also making their mark. 

Both, our team and doctor Jack Hanmann, have had our hands full all this time. Photographing corpses, looking for diatoms, centrifuging test tubes, injecting, cutting, stitching, and as a result ... [b]vertical slice![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/5e8481555e19e381ae456c881cd10e07e36fa547.png[/img]

Sweaty foreheads, dirty hands, but we are happy to officially announce that we have completed the next major milestone with the Autopsy Simulator project! Since the release of the demo, two more chapters have appeared in the project. We fixed bugs, polished the graphics, but more importantly, we conducted three detailed autopsies and... something unusual disturbed Jack Hanman's everyday life. Curious what happened?

A lot of solid work is behind us, but it's not time for a coffee break yet. We don't stop and keep on creating next chapters, bodies and mechanics to make the game that will be somewhat scary, sometimes disgusting, but definitely a unique experience.

So meanwhile, you new adepts of the art of studying the dead, use this time to get a solid grasp of anatomy, laboratory procedures, and… gag reflexes, so that you are ready for the ultimate test at the autopsy table. 
And since we have broken this long sepulchral silence, as an apology, we're opening the dissecting room door a crack and posting some new screenshots from the game. Hope you like it!

notes.title: Autopsy devlog #6
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Pathologists![/b][/h3]

Soon it will be a month since our project was updated... Time to catch up on it 😉 Before we start the show "Camera among the dead", something about what we have already done, what else will be done and of course what you can expect in Autopsy Simulator.

[b]First of all: body parts.[/b]

Our reliable 3D graphic designer has prepared several models of body parts especially for you. We know that you love them - so do we 😉 Because we come to you as always full of love, today we will start with a bloody heart ❤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/2a6d64b5dbf9b5313dd6bb1fccff44dc58496ab0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/2173b2fc674036a5dbd6afe0771e95bb185e270b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/e93b58f1a3a469d68909c6abce0d97bccd7f19f4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/79cacf08301c2887571f25d7ed7c79f287003ba0.png[/img]

But Autopsy Simulator wouldn't be a good game without a good script 😉 Today we present you a little excerpt:

[i]- [sleepy] Christ, what a dream. I overslept? Probably not.[/i]
Jack finds a black and white picture of Alice on the nightstand. The photo has a mourning black ribbon on the corner.
[i]- Hi, honey. I think it's time to put you in a drawer... Yes, you will be better here.[/i]
While hanging around the apartment, Jack finds a photo together with Alice and her brother Steven. All three of them are young, wearing coats.
[i]- Studies. Hours later I had a fight with the door and barely made it home. Eh... Those were the times...[/i]
There is a second photo in the hall - this time Jack is only in it with Steven. They sit at the bar table and smile.
[i]- Memorable "Evening of Disbelievers." You didn't believe I was hitting on Alice. Me, I'll have a cop for my brother-in-law. We almost had a fight then.[/i]

[b]Be ready for more… soon 😉 [/b]

In the comments - especially on Facebook - you ask us if this game will give you a choice: a mini horror game or just a simulator. Yes, if you do not like horror stories, because they do not make you feel relaxed, we assure you that in Autopsy Simulator you will have the option of which type of game you prefer 😉

Although we definitely recommend the story versions - it's really not that scary 😉 Well, maybe a little bit 😉

[h2][b]Finally, a little about the work progress itself:[/b][/h2]

[b]- we are constantly working on the graphics: [/b]we want both individual parts of the body and rooms to be refined. We have the most work to do with details such as decorations. For most people these details are the most important in the game 😉

[b]- we refine the script[/b] - we improve dialogues and selection options

[b]- mechanics [/b]- we have added various types of deaths to the game that you will have to discover in order to advance to the next missions. However, how it will work will remain a mystery for now (wait for the demo!). In addition, it also implements items into the game that you will be able to view and that will be a hint for you.

notes.title: Autopsy Simulator devlog #5
notes.content:
[b]Hello Pathologists!
[/b]
Today we have some news for you 😊
The most important thing - [b]DEMO! [/b]We know that you are waiting for such news! So listen up: we've just started internal testing! We still have a few things to do - first of all, to fix bugs that arose after applying the mechanics.

Here are some illustrations from Autopsy Simulator:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/0ebb38ce103a21c125bb266fb56c2e4936e9430b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37485356/8991a9d5dfce55eb0be68eeb54c4c9f64536d245.png[/img]

Speaking of the demo, we will also start official tests in some time. We will definitely let you know, because we will need support in this topic 😉

Finally: Autopsy Simulator is a combination of a classic simulator and a horror story. As players, you will have the option to choose whether you want to play by solving puzzles or just be a virtual pathologist.

A few things remain to be corrected and implemented, but we are closer than further, so keep an eye out for information here and on our discord ⬇️⬇️⬇️
